content.value: Classify the following probability as classical, relative frequency, or subjective:(10)
(i) The probability that tuition will increase next year is 0.95.
(ii) The probability of scoring on a penalty shot in the World Cup Football 2018 is 0.47.
(iii) The probability that you will win the lottery is 0.00062.
(iv) The probability a randomly selected flight will arrive on time is 0.875.
(v) The probability that you will go to Europe this year is 0.14.
